title: AZREIA members — Green Light Buying Machine
description: For AZREIA members: build certified co-living conversions with us, or buy a finished one.
heading: Two ways to work with us
lede: Certified PadSplit co-living properties. Some AZREIA members build them with us. Others buy the finished homes. Both start with a conversation.

items.title: Become a student
items.body: You buy the distressed house, finance it your usual way, and run your own crew — nothing about the acquisition changes. We coach the conversion, certify the finished property against documented standards, and list it for registered buyers. What changes is who buys it at the end.
items.note: Requires: 10–15 completed flips and a crew already working.

items.title: Get on the buyer list
items.body: Certified co-living properties as they're listed — converted, furnished, launched on PadSplit, with the certification documentation attached so you can see how the house was built. Houses close vacant, so you set the rates, the rules and the room mix from day one.
items.note: Requires: pre-qualification, so we know you can close when a house comes up.

blocks.heading: A free co-living property evaluation
blocks.body:
Send us an address and we’ll tell you whether it converts, roughly what room count it supports, and what the conversion would involve — including when the answer is no. A quick no on the wrong house is worth more than a slow maybe.

AZREIA members are also first to see certified properties as they come available, and get a free copy of The Green Light Buying Machine.

Send us a property

columns.body:
Retail flip margins have thinned and every operator is bidding on the same inventory. A co-living conversion changes who buys the house: an investor pricing the property on what it earns by the room rather than on comps down the street.

We build to a floor of eight bedrooms and two bathrooms, ensuite wherever the numbers support it, furnished and launched on PadSplit.

Brian and Gina Kingdeski have been flipping together for 26 years and have done north of 2,300 deals in the Phoenix metro. They also own Trinity Design and Construction, which is where the build standards came from — this sits on top of a construction company, not a marketing company.

Happy to speak at an AZREIA meeting or run a workshop on conversion, PadSplit standards, and underwriting a house by rentable room.

blocks.heading: What a finished one looks like
blocks.lede: Not renderings. Houses converted, furnished and put into service.

blocks.heading: Come and talk to us
blocks.body: Whether you'd build one or buy one, the first step is the same — a conversation.
